text:
olga-partner: Heads up  ingestion spike from Nebula partner: a huge usage delta for their "edge-meter" SKU last night. Looks like a 60x increase for a handful of customers. sample payload attached.

mike-eng: paste the sample? my first guess is unit mismatch (minutes vs seconds) but let's confirm.

olga-partner: sample: ```json
{"device_id":"neb-77","timestamp":"2026-04-18T03:00:00Z","sku":"edge-meter","active_time":3600}
```
(note: partner docs previously defined active_time in minutes).

rajesh-billing: If active_time is treated as minutes by our ingestion we would have billed 3600 minutes (=60 hours) vs expected 3600 seconds (=60 minutes) or vice versa. Which mapping are we using currently?

lina-integrations: Our schema label is `active_time_minutes` in the canonical RPC, but partner had been sending `active_time` (documented as minutes historically). Looks like recent agent v4.0 changed `active_time` to seconds to support sub-minute granularity. No version bump notice received.

sam-ops: Consequence: system created provisional ledger rows, many became invoiceable before we noticed -> a handful of customers might see large usage spikes on invoices.

rajesh-billing: We need to stop further processing of ambiguous `active_time` values until we determine units. Short term: treat `active_time` as ambiguous and move to quarantine for partner->confirm. Also flag any invoiceable rows created in the window as pending reversal.

mike-eng: Proposed mitigation:
- immediate: add a validation rule: if payload has `active_time` without explicit unit field and partner reported agent >= v4.0, quarantine.
- short-term: roll a hotfix to mark all `active_time` rows in the affected window as non-invoiceable and create exception ledger entries.
- long-term: enforce explicit units (seconds|minutes) in schema v2 and add agent-version header check.

olga-partner: partner ops confirms v4.0 changed to seconds to support higher fidelity. They failed to send a migration notice. Apologies. They're producing a mapping (device_id -> expected unit) and will patch agents to emit `active_time_seconds` explicitly.

lina-integrations: action items:
- lina: implement ambiguity quarantine + metric `ambiguous_active_time` (ETA 3h)
- mike-eng: hotfix to mark affected ledger rows non-invoiceable and create exception entries (ETA 4h)
- rajesh: prepare customer communication template and reversal/credit process (ETA 6h)
- olga-partner: request partner mapping and agent patch schedule (ETA 12h)

marketplace-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-1624 -> unit-mismatch-active-time-seconds-minutes (severity: high). Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-1624

sam-ops: Marketing delay? This impacts two paid customers in APAC and one enterprise pilot in EMEA. I'd recommend pausing any billing-driven public announcement for Nebula-related features until metrics stabilize.

olga-partner: agreed, partner asked us to pause any Nebula co-marketing for 48h.

mike-eng: hotfix deployed: affected ledger rows (2026-04-17T22:00Z - 2026-04-18T06:00Z) marked non-invoiceable; provisional credits issued to balance the temporary invoiceable spike. quarantine path live.

lina-integrations: quarantine holds ~1.2k rows across 3 customers. awaiting mapping CSV. added alert if ambiguous rate >0.2% per hour.

olga-partner: partner uploaded mapping CSV at 2026-04-18T07:05Z mapping device_id -> unit (seconds/minutes). They also published agent patch v4.1 which emits `active_time_seconds` explicitly.

mike-eng: backfill started using partner mapping; conversion rule: if unit==seconds convert to minutes for our canonical ledger unless partner requests seconds-based billing (they don't). If ambiguous, mark for manual review.

rajesh-billing: backfill complete; exception ledger reconciled; credits reversed where appropriate; invoices for affected customers were updated and a corrected statement issued.

sam-ops: partner agreed to a joint postmortem and a pre-announce checklist for agent/version notices. marketing pause lifted.

olga-partner: thanks everyone  partner will add a migration notice step to their release workflow. closing loop once postmortem doc is shared.

marketplace-bot: Update: incident #INC-2026-1624 status -> resolved. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/PM-2026-1624

mike-eng: uploaded hotfix notes and test vectors to PARTNERSHIP-METRICS-2026 epic.

rajesh-billing: customer comms sent and accounting adjust entries filed. moving to closed. :white_check_mark:
